title: About Item
description: One framework, plugin or library of the 'about the platform' list (mirrors @selfhelp/shared IAboutItem).

name.description: Product or package name, e.g. 'PHP', 'doctrine/orm' or 'sh2-shp-survey-js'.

version.description: Exact version. null when the caller may not see versions, or when it cannot be read.

license.description: SPDX id or a short text; several licences are joined with ' OR '. null when unknown.
